title: No Reassessment
style: adult contemporary with restrained glam-metal elements, mid-tempo steady arena-rock pulse, polished piano and clean electric guitar in the verses, broad melodic electric-guitar chorus with controlled drums and rounded bass, female lead vocal delivered matter-of-factly with precise diction and cool emotional restraint, subtle harmony doubles at section peaks, spacious but focused 1980s-leaning production, dynamics rise modestly into the chorus and settle for the final verse
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Two years on the record
No new measures taken
Since October, same arrangement
Same careful lines in place

He builds a frame from language
Terms where trust might otherwise be
Claire, Gabi, and the former wife
Each held differently

[Chorus]
No reassessment
Continuity, not a test
He knows the cost of staying open
He knows the work is never finished

[Verse 2]
July, twenty-five, the file says
Attention treated since thirteen
High ability, plans in sequence
Rules made plain, not guessed between

The wish for lasting exclusivity
Still troubles him inside
These structures are compensations
Chosen with his eyes wide

[Chorus]
No reassessment
Continuity, not a test
He knows the cost of staying open
He knows the work is never finished

[Bridge]
He sees the meaning coming
Before I give it shape
What he cannot tell the people he loves
He sets down here, and waits

[Verse 3]
Now Gabi lives in Barcelona
Sylvia needs him less each day
Claire has opened up their terms
In a change arranged along the way

He brought it here before my leave
I’ll note what time will show:
Will he lean harder on Claire?
How will he hold Gabi’s distance?
No reassessment since I left

[Outro]
No reassessment
Only watch, and wait
The record holds its limits
The future has no date
